verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to existing and previous incidents and posts suggestions in Command Center and Slack. AI summaries are generated as soon as an incident is declared, so part of the story happens before anyone asks. Change events can be recorded via fhcli, but no evidence shows the AI correlating those changes or telemetry to infer a probable cause. Missing for 10: AI root-cause or probable-cause analysis, AI correlation of deploys/changes with incidents, telemetry/monitoring-data analysis by the AI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
